charts.title: The three-point race, 1996-97 to today
charts.subtitle: Cumulative regular-season threes made since 1996-97, top 12 after each season
charts.hook: Stephen Curry has made 4,290 regular-season threes since 1996-97, more than anyone else over that span (through 2026-27).

charts.title: The three-point takeover
charts.subtitle: Share of all NBA field-goal attempts taken from behind the arc, regular season
charts.hook: In 1997-98, 16% of NBA shots were threes, about 1 in 6. In 2026-27: 43%, about 4 in 10.

charts.title: Where the midrange went
charts.subtitle: Change in the share of all shots taken from each spot on the floor: the last three seasons against 1997-98 to 2000-01. Regular season, shots inside 4 ft of the rim left out, hexagons two feet wide
charts.hook: From 1997-98 to 2000-01, 39% of NBA shots were midrange twos and 17% were threes. From 2024-25 to 2026-27: 15% midrange, 42% threes.

charts.title: Going for it on 4th-and-short
charts.subtitle: Share of 4th-and-1 or 2 plays where the offense went for it instead of kicking. Quarters 1-3, score within one possession, regular season
charts.hook: In 1999, teams went for it on close-game 4th-and-short 22% of the time. In 2026: 55%. On their own side of midfield it went from 2% to 26%.

charts.title: Run vs. pass: how often the NFL drops back
charts.subtitle: Share of offensive plays that were dropbacks (passes, sacks, scrambles), regular season
charts.hook: On early downs with the game in doubt, offenses dropped back 52% of the time in 1999. In 2026 it is 53%; the peak was 55% in 2020.

charts.title: The kickoff return is back
charts.subtitle: What happens on a regular-season kickoff, 1999 to today
charts.hook: In 1999, 87% of kickoffs were returned. By 2023 it was 23%. In 2026: 82%.

charts.title: The passing-yards race, 1999 to today
charts.subtitle: Cumulative regular-season passing yards since 1999, top 12 after each season
charts.hook: T.Brady leads everyone who has thrown a pass since 1999 with 89,216 yards (through 2026).

charts.title: Win-probability rollercoaster of the week
charts.subtitle: Week 9, 2026: Cleveland Browns at New Orleans Saints (2026-11-08). Final CLE 22 - NO 23.
charts.hook: Week 9: New Orleans Saints were down to a 22% chance of winning in the fourth quarter and won anyway. Final CLE 22 - NO 23.
